wins: Damage opponents first, then cast spells: Abaddon gives cascade to spells with mana value up to the life opponents lost that turn, so every big spell brings a free one.
plan: Mana rocks and Herald of Slaanesh (Daemons cost 2 less and gain haste).
Attack first, or ping with Knight Paladin or Kill! Maim! Burn!. Cast your big spells in the second main phase, after damage, so they cascade.
Bloodthirster for extra combats, Reaver Titan for 5 to each opponent per attack, Blood for the Blood God! for 8 to each opponent and a fresh hand.
keys: The engine. Order matters: damage, then spells.
Draws a card for every Daemon you control; the deck has 16.
Steals creatures and turns them on their owners.
Exiles a creature and gives the wielder its power.
tips: Kharn the Betrayer prevents damage to himself and switches sides, and you draw two cards when he does.
Darkness prevents all combat damage for a turn: your emergency fog.
Blasphemous Act and Let the Galaxy Burn reset the table when you’re behind.
Cascade is automatic in Playmat: it flips cards and asks if you want to cast the hit. Say yes.
mulligan: Keep hands with 3–4 lands, a mana rock and something to do by turn 3. Abaddon needs all three colors.
